config.autojs6.server.port.description: Port the extension listens on for AutoJs6 client mode.
config.autojs6.server.confirmUnknownDevi: Ask before accepting an unknown AutoJs6 device (client mode); devices that scanned the QR code or were remembered are accepted silently.
config.autojs6.client.port.description: Default port of AutoJs6 server mode.

config.autojs6.adb.path.description: Path to the adb executable or its directory.
config.autojs6.discovery.enabled.descrip: Discover AutoJs6 6.8.0+ devices running server mode on the LAN via mDNS when connecting.
config.autojs6.connection.heartbeatInter: Heartbeat interval in milliseconds, 0 to disable.

config.autojs6.connection.maxReconnectAt: Max reconnect attempts per session, 0 = limited only by reconnectTimeout.
config.autojs6.connection.reconnectTimeo: Total reconnect window in seconds, 0 = unlimited.
config.autojs6.connection.reconnectMaxDe: Upper bound of the reconnect backoff delay in milliseconds.
config.autojs6.connection.restoreOnStart: Reconnect on startup to the targets that were connected when VSCode closed.
